review_candidates.title: AI Modernization Manager - LATAM
review_candidates.description: We're seeking an AI Modernization Manager to join us at Space Inch. You'll be embedded with one of our longtime clients - a fast-growing platform in the payments and commerce space serving thousands of merchants across physical and digital gift card programs. As the client has scaled, critical business logic has grown outside their core platform: undocumented legacy applications, scripts, and manual processes that keep the business running but that aren't documentation. This role owns discovery, planning, and coordination for the resulting modernization program, turning that hidden estate into a roadmap engineering can build against. AI is expected to be a big part of how you work day to day, not just for individual tasks but to build workflows the wider team can reuse for discovery, documentation, planning, and risk tracking. Our Mission, Vision, and Values At Space Inch, we prioritize alignment with our clients and team, ensuring a deep understanding of their needs. We are committed to delivering exceptional work while supporting the personal and professional growth of our team members. Working at Space Inch Our team is around 80+ people, primarily based in Croatia, but also members in the rest of the Europe, South America, and the US; the product team mostly being in the US, and engineering in Croatia and Brazil We are remote-first, but occasional travel may be required, e.g. for annual company retreats We work on end-to-end projects with a long-term vision We strongly support work-life balance for our team members, even though we work in different time zones Requirements 7+ years of experience in product management, technical discovery, systems analysis, legacy modernization, or similar hybrid technical/delivery role - with product management experience a must-have within that mix Experience with application architecture, APIs, databases, integrations, reporting, scheduled jobs, and both cloud and on-prem infrastructure Proven ability to dig into an unfamiliar, poorly documented system - reading code, interviewing stakeholders, and reconstructing context that was never written down, without waiting for someone to hand you a process Ability to turn business and operational needs into requirements and plans that engineering can build against (i.e. architecture diagrams, runbooks, and monitoring/support handoff documentation) Understanding of the software delivery, release management, observability, support, and operational handover well enough to hold engineering accountable to it Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience operating at the intersection of engineering teams, business stakeholders, and external partners Readiness to push on missing information or challenging assumptions Hands-on experience using AI for investigation, analysis, documentation, or workflow improvement - not just familiarity with the idea Ability to read .NET code and architecture to evaluate designs, ask sharp questions, and sanity-check what engineering delivers, even though you won't be writing production code in this role Bonus points Experience with transaction systems or reporting platforms Experience with Windows-based legacy applications and hybrid (cloud + on-prem) infrastructure Experience working with or managing relationships with a managed service provider (MSP) What You'll Do Technical and business discovery: Investigate legacy applications, scripts, and manual processes to understand what they do, why they exist, and what depends on them. Document how these systems actually behave and maintain a knowledge base Modernization planning: Decide whether each capability should be kept, replaced, consolidated, automated, or retired, and turn that into a prioritized roadmap. Keep the roadmap current against real business priorities and deadlines Delivery and stakeholder coordination: Coordinate initiatives from discovery through release and handover. Work across engineering, QA, Operations, business stakeholders, the MSP, and outside partners Operational readiness and risk management: Ensure everything that ships has requirements, documentation, monitoring, and an owner behind it. Track material risks to resolution Continuous improvement and AI-enabled workflows: Turn recurring manual work across discovery, planning, development, QA, release, and maintenance, into templates and reusable AI-assisted workflows for discovery, documentation, and risk tracking Qualities for Success Proactive investigator: You dig in and pull information out of both people and systems, and keep asking questions until undocumented context is actually reconstructed Decisive planner: You can look at a messy capability and make (and defend) a real keep/replace/consolidate/retire call Documentation-minded by default: Diagrams, runbooks, and written context aren't extra steps for you, they're part of how you think through a problem Cross-functional communicator: Equally credible talking to an engineer about architecture and a business stakeholder about impact and timeline AI-fluent, not AI-dependent: You build reusable AI workflows for discovery and documentation, but you verify what AI gives you against real sources Where You've Likely Developed These Skills Technical product management, systems analysis, or legacy modernization roles inside complex, legacy-heavy environments (e.g., fintech, payments, retail tech, or platforms going through modernization) Roles that required you to reverse-engineer systems with little or no documentation Consulting, agency, or professional services backgrounds where you had to build trust with a client's internal teams quickly You're a Great Fit If You Genuinely enjoy the "detective work" of figuring out how something actually functions, not just reading the ticket about it Already use AI as part of how you investigate, document, and plan - and want to build that into repeatable team workflows Are comfortable challenging and verifying technical outcomes without being the one who designs or builds them This Role is Not a Fit If You Prefer working from a fully specified backlog rather than building the picture yourself Are uncomfortable reading code or working directly with technical systems Have only surface familiarity with AI tools rather than real, hands-on use for investigation or documentation work Compensation And Benefits Compensation: $4.500,00 - $5.500/monthly for a B2B engagement, based on experience and skills Remote-first setup Health & Wellbeing: 100% paid sick leave + annual health checkup Stay active: Wellness subsidy Continuous Growth: An education budget specifically designed to fuel your learning and help you expand your knowledge base Extra perks: Referral bonus Space Inch is not responsible for any job boards scraping this ad without showing the position as remote, but Peru/Colombia exclusive. Applicants from other countries will not be considered. Space Inch is committed to providing an environment of equal employment opportunity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. This commitment extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, compensation, benefits, and termination. Space Inch believes in treating all employees and applicants with respect and dignity, fostering a workplace where everyone has the opportunity to succeed.

review_candidates.title: سكرتارية تنفيذية
review_candidates.description: سكرتارية تنفيذية من سكان العاشر من رمضان تتعدد المهام التي يقوم بها السكرتير التنفيذي لتشمل جوانب تنظيمية وإدارية مختلفة، ويمكن تلخيص أبرز المهام الوظيفية للسكرتير التنفيذي في النقاط التالية: تنظيم الجدول الزمني للمدير التنفيذي يتولى السكرتير التنفيذي مسؤولية تنظيم مواعيد المدير التنفيذي وجدول الأعمال اليومية له، وتتطلب هذه المهمة دقة عالية لضمان عدم وجود تعارض بين الاجتماعات والمهام الأخرى، كما يضمن السكرتير ترتيب الأولويات بما يتماشى مع الأهداف الإستراتيجية للمدير، ويتعين عليه التأكد من تخصيص الوقت الكافي لكل اجتماع بما يناسب أهميته، ومنح المدير الوقت اللازم للاستعداد أو التنقل بين الاجتماعات. إدارة المراسلات والاتصالات تتطلب هذه المهمة أن يكون السكرتير التنفيذي على دراية تامة بأولويات المدير التنفيذي ومعرفة كيفية توجيه المراسلات للأشخاص المناسبين، فيتعامل مع البريد الإلكتروني والمكالمات الهاتفية والرسائل الواردة، ويقوم بفرز هذه المراسلات وفقًا لأهميتها ومدى الحاجة لاتخاذ إجراءات فورية، وفي بعض الأحيان، قد يكون السكرتير التنفيذي هو نقطة الاتصال الأولى مع العملاء أو الشركاء الخارجيين ما يتطلب مهارات تواصل ممتازة لضمان ترك انطباع جيد عن الشركة. إعداد التقارير والعروض التقديمية يشارك السكرتير التنفيذي مباشرة في إعداد التقارير الإدارية والمالية التي تُعرض على المدير التنفيذي والإدارة العليا، بالإضافة إلى ذلك، يقوم بإعداد العروض التقديمية اللازمة لاجتماعات المدير التنفيذي مع الموظفين أو الشركاء الخارجيين، ما يتطلب القدرة على تحويل المعلومات المعقدة إلى عروض بصرية واضحة وسهلة الفهم. التنسيق بين الأقسام يعمل السكرتير التنفيذي صلة وصل بين الإدارة العليا وبقية الأقسام في الشركة، فيضمن من خلال التنسيق الفعال أن يتم تنفيذ المهام والمشاريع دون تأخير أو تداخل بين المسؤوليات المختلفة، كما يساعد التواصل المستمر مع الأقسام على تحديد العقبات المحتملة أو التحديات التي قد تؤثر على سير العمل وحلها قبل أن تتفاقم. تنظيم السفريات والفعاليات تنظيم جميع تفاصيل سفر المدير التنفيذي، سواء كانت مرتبطة باجتماعات عمل أو فعاليات خارجية، ويشمل ذلك حجز تذاكر السفر والترتيب للإقامة وجدولة الاجتماعات الخارجية مع الشركاء أو العملاء، إضافة إلى ذلك، يمكن أن يتضمن دوره تنظيم الفعاليات الكبرى مثل المؤتمرات أو ورش العمل التي يشارك فيها المدير التنفيذي، ما يتطلب قدرة على التعامل مع التفاصيل اللوجستية والتنسيق مع الجهات الخارجية. إدارة المعلومات الحساسة يُعهد إلى السكرتير التنفيذي بمسؤولية التعامل مع المعلومات الحساسة المتعلقة بالشركة والمدير التنفيذي، مثل ملفات الموظفين والاتفاقيات التجارية والتقارير المالية، ما يتطلب الالتزام بأعلى معايير السرية والأمان لضمان عدم وصولها لأشخاص غير مصرح لهم، كما يجب أن يكون السكرتير التنفيذي قادرًا على إدارة هذه المعلومات بطريقة منظمة لتسهيل الوصول إليها عند الحاجة.

review_candidates.title: Senior QA Engineer
review_candidates.description: We're looking for a talented Senior QA Engineer to join Procore's Product & Technology organization. In this role, you will drive the design, development, and evolution of automated testing solutions that ensure the quality, reliability, and scalability of both customer-facing and internal applications. You will partner closely with Software Engineers, Product Managers, Designers, DevOps Engineers, and fellow Quality Engineers to embed automation throughout the software development lifecycle. We're looking for an engineer who is passionate about building robust automation frameworks, improving developer productivity, and leveraging AI-powered tools to accelerate software quality. This role reports to the Quality Assurance Manager and is based in Cairo, Egypt. What You Will Do Design, build, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for web, API, and end-to-end testing. Develop reliable, maintainable, and reusable automated test suites that support continuous delivery. Collaborate with software engineers to integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and improve release quality. Define automation strategies and establish best practices for test architecture, code quality, and framework design. Review product requirements, technical designs, and implementation plans to identify quality risks and improve testability. Perform API, integration, regression, end-to-end, and exploratory testing when needed to ensure comprehensive coverage. Investigate test failures, analyze defects, identify root causes, and partner with engineering teams to resolve issues. Improve test execution speed, stability, and reliability by optimizing automation frameworks and reducing flaky tests. Drive quality metrics, automation coverage, and continuous improvement initiatives across engineering teams. Leverage AI-powered tools and coding assistants to accelerate test automation development, test generation, debugging, defect analysis, and engineering productivity. Contribute to the adoption of AI-assisted quality engineering practices and help establish best practices across the organization. Mentor other Quality Engineers on automation best practices, framework design, coding standards, and modern testing techniques. Stay current with emerging automation technologies, AI capabilities, and industry best practices to continuously improve Procore's quality engineering practices to improve Procore's quality engineering practices continuously What we're looking for Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 5+ years of experience in software quality engineering with a strong focus on test automation. Strong programming skills in Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#, or Python. Hands-on experience designing and building automation frameworks using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar. Experience automating REST APIs using tools such as Postman, Rest Assured, Playwright API, or equivalent. Strong understanding of software engineering principles, object-oriented programming, and design patterns. Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated tests into modern deployment workflows. Strong SQL skills and experience validating data across distributed systems. Experience testing cloud-native applications, distributed systems, or microservices architectures. Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Git, and modern software development practices. Experience with performance, reliability, or security testing is a plus. Experience using AI-powered tools such as ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Windsurf, or similar to improve engineering and automation workflows. Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.

review_candidates.title: Senior Purchasing Specialist
review_candidates.description: Geeks Store is hiring a proactive and commercially minded Purchasing Specialist to manage purchasing activities across our technology product categories. The role involves supplier sourcing, purchasing, cost and pricing analysis, stock planning, product research, and negotiation , while working closely with Sales, Finance, Warehouse, and Management to maintain healthy inventory levels and profitability. Key Responsibilities Manage the purchasing cycle from identifying requirements and sourcing suppliers to purchase orders, delivery follow-up, and stock receiving. Source and evaluate local and international suppliers , comparing prices, availability, payment terms, lead times, and reliability. Negotiate with suppliers to secure the best purchase prices, discounts, credit/payment terms, and commercial conditions . Monitor sales performance, stock levels, sales velocity, and market demand to plan replenishment, maintain availability of fast-moving products, and avoid overstocking. Analyze purchasing opportunities based on product cost, market selling price, expected margin, competition, and sales potential to support Buy / Don’t Buy decisions. Monitor market prices and competitor availability to support competitive and profitable pricing decisions. Research and evaluate new and trending technology products and categories based on market demand, competition, expected margin, and fit with Geeks Store's customer segment. Monitor slow-moving and aging inventory and coordinate with relevant teams on actions to improve stock turnover. Create and manage purchase orders through Odoo ERP , ensuring accurate products, quantities, costs, and supplier information. Follow up with suppliers on open orders, shipments, delivery dates, shortages, defective products, returns, replacements, and other purchasing issues. Coordinate with Finance, Warehouse, Sales, and Operations regarding supplier payments, receiving, inventory requirements, and purchasing priorities. Maintain accurate purchasing and supplier data and provide regular reports and recommendations on stock availability, supplier performance, purchasing opportunities, and profitability . Requirements 2–4 years of experience in Purchasing, Procurement, or a similar commercial purchasing role. Experience in electronics, IT hardware, laptops, consumer electronics, retail, or technology products is highly preferred. Strong understanding of purchasing, supplier management, quotations, purchase orders, and negotiation . Good commercial understanding of cost, margin, market pricing, inventory, sales velocity, and stock turnover . Strong negotiation, communication, research, and supplier management skills . Very good Excel / Google Sheets skills; experience with Odoo or other ERP systems is preferred. High attention to detail with strong organization, follow-up, and problem-solving skills . Ability to take ownership, work independently, and make commercially sound recommendations. Good command of English , especially for communication with international suppliers. Work Conditions Location: Sheraton, Cairo Working Days: 5 days per week Working Hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM
